actions.description: Archive an item in monday.com (sets state to archived, distinct from delete).
actions.name: archive-item

item_id.description: The ID of the item to archive. Example: "2933609588"

actions.description: Change a monday.com item column value.
actions.name: change-column-value

item_id.description: The ID of the item to update. Example: "2933609588"

column_id.description: The ID of the column to update. Example: "task_status"

board_id.description: The ID of the board containing the item. Example: "5096980653"

value.description: The new column value as a JSON-formatted string. Example: "{\"label\":\"Done\"}"

create_labels_if_missing.description: If true, creates new Status or Dropdown labels that do not already exist.

id.description: The ID of the updated item.

name.description: The name of the updated item.

column_values.description: The column values of the updated item.

actions.description: Create a board in monday.com.
actions.name: create-board

board_name.description: The new board's name. Example: "My Board"

board_kind.description: The type of board to create.

workspace_id.description: The workspace ID to create the board in. Example: "6502905"

empty.description: Creates an empty board without any default items.

board_owner_ids.description: A list of user IDs who will be board owners.

board_subscriber_ids.description: A list of user IDs who will subscribe to the board.

prompt.description: An AI prompt to generate the board's structure and content.

actions.description: Create a column in monday.com.
actions.name: create-column

board_id.description: The ID of the board to add the column to. Example: "5096980653"

title.description: The display title for the new column.

column_type.description: The type of column to create. Example: "text", "status", "numbers"

description.description: An optional description shown in the column header tooltip.

actions.description: Create a group in monday.com.
actions.name: create-group

relative_to.description: Group ID to position relative to.

actions.description: Create an item in monday.com.
actions.name: create-item

board_id.description: The board ID to create the item on. Example: "5096980653"

group_id.description: The group ID to create the item in. Example: "topics"

item_name.description: The name of the new item.

column_values.description: Column values as a JSON object. Keys are column IDs, values are type-specific.

create_labels_if_missing.description: Whether to create missing status/dropdown labels.

relative_to.description: The item ID to position the new item relative to.

position_relative_method.description: Position relative to the specified item.

actions.description: Create a subitem under a parent item in monday.com.
actions.name: create-subitem

item_name.description: The new subitem name. Example: "Design mockup"

actions.description: Create a update in monday.com.
actions.name: create-update

item_id.description: The item ID to create the update on. Example: "2933609588"

body.description: The update text. HTML formatting is supported.

parent_id.description: The parent update ID to reply to. Omit for top-level updates.

actions.description: Delete or archive a board in monday.com.
actions.name: delete-board

board_id.description: The unique identifier of the board to delete or archive. Example: "5096980653"

permanent.description: If true, permanently deletes the board. If false or omitted, archives the board.

actions.description: Delete or archive a column in monday.com.
actions.name: delete-column

board_id.description: The unique identifier of the board that contains the column to delete. Example: "5096980653"

column_id.description: The unique identifier of the column to delete. Example: "task_status"

id.description: The unique identifier of the deleted column.

actions.description: Delete or archive a group in monday.com.
actions.name: delete-group

permanent.description: If true, permanently deletes the group. If false or omitted, archives the group (soft delete).

actions.description: Delete or archive an item in monday.com.
actions.name: delete-item

item_id.description: The item ID to delete or archive. Example: "2933609588"

permanent.description: If true, permanently delete the item. If false or omitted, archive the item (recoverable).

actions.description: Delete an update in monday.com.
actions.name: delete-update

updateId.description: The unique identifier of the update to delete. Example: "1234567890"

id.description: The unique identifier of the deleted update.

actions.description: Duplicate a board in monday.com.
actions.name: duplicate-board

board_id.description: The ID of the board to duplicate. Example: "5096980653"

duplicate_type.description: The type of duplication to perform.

board_name.description: The name for the duplicated board.

workspace_id.description: The workspace ID to place the duplicated board in.

folder_id.description: The folder ID to place the duplicated board in.

keep_subscribers.description: Whether to keep subscribers on the duplicated board.

actions.description: Retrieve a single board from monday.com.

actions.description: Retrieve a single column from monday.com.
actions.name: get-column

actions.description: Retrieve a single group from monday.com.
actions.name: get-group

board_id.description: The board ID that contains the group. Example: "5096980653"

group_id.description: The group ID to retrieve. Example: "topics"

actions.description: Retrieve a single item from monday.com.
actions.name: get-item

item_id.description: The unique identifier of the item to retrieve. Example: "2933609588"

actions.description: Retrieve a single subitem from monday.com.
actions.name: get-subitem

subitem_id.description: The ID of the subitem to retrieve. Example: "2933645613"

actions.description: Retrieve a single team from monday.com.
actions.name: get-team

team_id.description: The unique identifier of the team to retrieve. Example: "13240071"

actions.description: Retrieve a single update from monday.com.
actions.name: get-update

update_id.description: The unique identifier of the update. Example: "579526624"

actions.description: Retrieve a single user from monday.com
actions.name: get-user

userId.description: The unique identifier of the user. Example: "104094154"

actions.description: Retrieve a single workspace from monday.com.

actions.description: List boards from monday.com
actions.name: list-boards

ids.description: Specific board IDs to return. Example: ["5096980653"]

board_kind.description: The type of board to return.

state.description: The state of the board to return. Defaults to active.

workspace_ids.description: Workspace IDs that contain the boards to return. Example: ["6502905"]

limit.description: The number of boards to return. Defaults to 25.

page.description: The page number to return. Starts at 1.

actions.description: List columns from monday.com
actions.name: list-columns

board_id.description: Board ID to filter columns by. Example: "5096980653"

limit.description: Maximum number of boards to retrieve per page.

page.description: Page number for board pagination. Omit for the first page.

actions.description: List groups from monday.com.
actions.name: list-groups

board_id.description: The board ID to list groups from. Example: "5096980653"

ids.description: Optional group IDs to filter by.

actions.description: List items from monday.com.
actions.name: list-items

board_id.description: The board ID to list items from. Example: "5096980653"

limit.description: Number of items to return. Maximum is 500. Default is 25.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

query_params.description: Filter, sort, and scope parameters. Cannot be used with cursor.

actions.description: List subitems of a parent item in monday.com.
actions.name: list-subitems

actions.description: List teams from monday.com.
actions.name: list-teams

cursor.description: Pagination cursor (page number). Omit for the first page.

limit.description: Number of teams to return per page. Default: 25.

actions.description: List updates from monday.com.
actions.name: list-updates

cursor.description: Pagination cursor (page number) from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

limit.description: Number of updates to return per page. Default: 25. Maximum: 100.

from_date.description: Start of date range filter in ISO 8601 format. Must be used with to_date.

to_date.description: End of date range filter in ISO 8601 format. Must be used with from_date.

actions.description: List users from monday.com
actions.name: list-users

limit.description: The number of users to return. Maximum 1000.

page.description: The page number to return. Starts at 1.

ids.description: The unique identifiers of specific users to return.

emails.description: The specific user emails to return.

name.description: A fuzzy search of users by name.

actions.description: List workspaces from monday.com.
actions.name: list-workspaces

limit.description: Number of workspaces to return per page. Min: 1, max: 100, default: 25.

state.description: Filter by workspace state. Default: active.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor (page number) from the previous response. Omit for the first page.
